name: Diabetes-Mellitus Prospective Benchmark for Auditable Concept Harmonisation
description: This dataset provides a redistribution-cleared 500-pair prospective benchmark for evaluating concept-equivalence decisions in bibliometric keyword harmonisation. The benchmark was constructed from PubMed Central source material for the diabetes-mellitus domain and contains 11 fields describing each keyword pair, source frequencies, candidate stratum, final adjudicated gold label, source licence, and contributing PMC identifiers. The final gold standard contains 161 match, 338 non-match, and 1 uncertain pair. Pair-level source provenance comprises 497 CC BY cases and 3 CC0 cases. The source acquisition retrieved 15,106 records on 7 September 2026, of which 1,066 strict-eligible records contributed 6,029 author-keyword occurrences representing 4,092 unique strings. The compiled benchmark is licensed CC BY 4.0; underlying PMC source articles retain their original CC BY or CC0 licences. Per-annotator labels, free-text justifications, adjudication notes, and title/abstract context evidence are not included.
